name: dsh-panel-pins
description: Keyboard-first sidebar panel launcher for DeepSeek Harness: grouped searchable Panels menu with hit highlighting, Alt+1..9 direct jumps, MRU, mirrored by a Ctrl+K command palette with named layout presets. Pin/top/hide/rename rows (drag-to-reorder with a drop indicator, Move-to-front fallback), custom groups, icon-only mode, compact footer, full Settings page, and settings export/import via clipboard, file AND drag-drop. v1.3.2: a single-hidden row that IS the active panel stays visible (leaving re-hides it; collection mode still suppresses; whitelist wins). v1.3.3: click-triggered feedback — a pre-filled GitHub issue, the plugin owner's own questionnaire, and a manual copy-diagnostics button; zero automatic reporting. v1.4.0: settings-only third-party pages are bridged into the Panels launcher (main-keyed panel + own child slot re-registered with the entry's top-level inject/store/locale; add/remove reconciliation, paired rollback, toggle + back bar). Display-layer only: no DOM surgery, clean uninstall, theme-token styling. THE primary install name; the @qdnbd scoped package is frozen at 1.2.1 (final alias).
author: QDNBD
